title: inr2action: Encoding Robot Episodes as Neural Implicit Representations for Recall and Action
abstract: arXiv:2610.28882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon robotic operation requires memory that scales with essential information rather than execution time. We present a parameter-space memory framework where each episode is stored as a separable object. A neural implicit representation is fitted to episode video from a shared, meta-learned initialization; the resulting weight delta constitutes the memory. Crucially, this delta remains a fixed size regardless of whether the episode spans a hundred or a hundred thousand frames. A learned projector maps the weight delta into token embeddings, conditioning a language model for question answering and a decoder for joint command regression, without frame retrieval at query time. On RoboMME, the language model exceeds chance across all question types, and the decoder achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.51. translated_title: inr2action：将机器人情节编码为神经隐式表示以实现回忆与动作
translated_abstract: 长时程机器人操作需要一种随关键信息而非执行时间扩展的记忆机制。我们提出了一种参数空间记忆框架，其中每个情节作为一个可分离的对象被存储。通过从一个共享的、元学习的初始值出发，对情节视频拟合神经隐式表示，所得的权重增量即构成记忆。关键在于，无论情节跨越一百帧还是十万帧，该增量始终保持固定大小。一个学习得到的投影器将权重增量映射为token嵌入，从而为问答的语言模型和执行关节命令回归的解码器提供条件，且在查询时无需进行帧检索。在RoboMME数据集上，语言模型在所有问题类型上的表现均超过随机水平，解码器达到平均R²为0.51。用匹配的噪声替换权重增量会使性能下降11.4分，而随机初始化的权重则无法解码，证明了元学习（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出将机器人操作情节编码为固定大小的神经隐式表示权重增量作为记忆，使记忆规模与情节时长无关，并能同时支持问答与关节命令回归，无需查询时检索帧。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes encoding robot episodes as fixed-size weight deltas of neural implicit representations, creating memory that scales with essential information rather than episode length, and supporting both question answering and joint command regression without frame retrieval at query time.
